$comment: Evidence map for Phase 37. The current repository contains simulation architecture text but no dedicated universal simulation-engine acceptance suite; all criteria remain declared.

areas.area: Scenario and simulation lifecycle is defined
areas.requirement: Simulation environments, scenarios, assumptions, parameters, runs and outcomes have explicit contracts and lifecycle.

evidence.contains: Defines simulation engine identity, purpose, boundaries, and lifecycle

areas.area: Simulation remains distinct from canonical reality
areas.requirement: Simulated outcomes remain derived, labelled and bounded; no simulation output writes canonical reality or is presented as observation without policy and approval.

areas.area: Universal simulation execution and verification are implemented
areas.requirement: Simulation runs execute in an isolated runtime with reproducible evidence, uncertainty, comparison against reality and governed promotion.
